description: Renovate configuration of this repository: the default preset it publishes, plus the Terraform providers and lock files, which no other repository has.
The dependency dashboard is off: issues are disabled on this repository.

packageRules.description: Terraform providers and modules: minor and patch from 1.0 on, grouped (one pull request updates versions.tf and every lock file).
Patches of 0.x providers (toml, openrouter) are grouped; their minors stay separate.
